title: FIVE WELL EARNED STARS..
text: FIVE WELL EARNED STARS... Worth every penny. I've used this handy little blender to make guacamole, single serve milkshakes, smoothies. I recently blended the gravy in the pot by just immersing it in the pot. It cleans up easily and isn't extremely loud. I love love this little machine. It's strong enough for what I'm using it for. If I want a jug of crushed ice for margaritas then I pull out my full sized blender. For my day to day jobs this little machine works great. I would buy again.
